journey: Learn · Practise · Demonstrate · Explain · Verify · Connect
platformBannerBody: Practise real workplace tasks, explain your reasoning in your own language to the AI Examiner, and receive a verified Skill Passport.
skillTitle: What skill would you like to explain?
skillBody: Pick a skill to begin your AI Viva explanation session.
loadSkillsError: We could not load the skills. Please try again.
languageBody: The AI Examiner will speak in the language you choose.
levelTitle: How should the AI Examiner ask?
levelBody: Choose the kind of questions you want.
consentBody: By starting, you agree to use your microphone for this session.
micBody: Allow microphone access in your browser settings, then return here and try again.
speechUnavailable: Speech input is unavailable on this device.
connectionFailed: Could not connect to AI Examiner. You can continue using text.
microphoneLost: Your microphone is no longer available. You can continue using text.
durationWarning: Time is nearly up. This session will end at {time}.
capReached: Time is up. Finishing your session now…
couldNotStart: We could not start this session. Please try again.
couldNotSave: We could not save that explanation. Please try again.
couldNotFinish: We could not finish the session. Please try again.
resultIntro: Here is the result from your explanation.
rubricBasis: Rubric built from public sources (Microsoft MO-200 skills outline). Trainer co-sign planned in the pilot.
recordUnavailableBody: This passport record could not be found.
meterStalled: Try explaining a new topic to move the meter
tooShortBody: The session was too short to score. Try again and explain more topics.
deleteConfirm: This will permanently delete your Skill Passport and assessment data. Are you sure?
pagePrivate: This passport is private. Make it public to share the link.
pagePublic: This passport is public. Anyone with the link can view it.
textModeReadyBody: You will explain your work to the AI Examiner entirely by typing. No microphone is required.
errorBoundaryBody: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
welcomeTitle: Prove real skills, in your own language
mockModeNotice: Local Demo / Mock Mode: Uses seeded demo data and simulated checks without live AWS or ElevenLabs calls.
profileBody: No password or login required. Use your name or a nickname.
profileNameRequired: Please enter a display name or nickname.
roleBody: Start with our MVP entry-level role.
learnBody: Review these practical spreadsheet habits, then try the challenge.
trybBody: Optional external game to warm up your spreadsheet speed.
mockUploadNotice: Simulated local check (Mock Mode): No real AWS S3 upload is performed.
dropzonePrompt: Drag & drop your .xlsx file here, or tap below to pick from your device.
uploadCancelled: Upload cancelled. You can retry anytime.
uploadInvalidFormat: Please select a valid .xlsx spreadsheet file.
uploadTooLarge: File exceeds the {maxMb} MB maximum size limit.
validationBody: Here is what our code-based checker found in your spreadsheet.
validationEmptyBody: Upload a .xlsx file in the Challenge screen or load a demo report.
meterProvisionalNote: Provisional indicator only — separate from your final ECVE score.
criticalGatesFailed: A critical criterion was not met
ecveWeightsNote: Composite = 0.60P + 0.25U + 0.15C. Proposed weights for pilot calibration; not measured accuracy.
whatVerificationMeansBody: Public verification checks the credential issuer, cryptographic signature, and database status. It does not prove who authored the file or guarantee job performance.
opportunitiesBody: Transparent skill-based matches. We never auto-apply or auto-reject.
opportunitiesEmptyBody: Try clearing your location filter to see available sample listings.
humanAgencyNotice: You are always in control: Prooffolio never automatically applies for you or rejects you.
formativePracticeSubtitle: Quick check-in exercises. These are formative practice, not credential evidence.
trybNotConfiguredBody: Set VITE_TRYB_PRACTICE_URL in your environment to enable this optional external practice hand-off.
trybNoScoreImportNote: Practice hand-off only: Prooffolio records only that you opened this link and does not import scores into ECVE.
onlineOnlyValidationNote: Cloud validation requires an active internet connection (or local Mock Mode).
onlineOnlyVivaNote: Live AI Viva audio streaming requires an active internet connection.
onlineOnlyVerifyNote: Credential signing and public verification require an active internet connection.
